name: personal-expense-tracker
description: College Student Friendly Personal Expense and Budget Tracker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix src/backend" "npm run dev --prefix src/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix src/backend && npm run build --prefix src/frontend
scripts.setup:backend: npm install --prefix src/backend && npm run db:setup --prefix src/backend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend

author: SDP Student Team
